title: FrameAxis: Characterizing Microframe Bias and Intensity with Word Embedding

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating "microframe bias" by computing the weighted average of word contributions (cosine similarity) to a semantic axis defined by antonym pairs using word embeddings, effectively quantifying how a text emphasizes certain perspectives over others.

Comparing the microframe bias and intensity of news headlines from conservative, center, and liberal media outlets on various political issues (e.g., immigration, gun control, abortion, and political parties) to measure partisan framing differences.
Evaluating microframe bias in positive versus negative restaurant reviews across different aspects (e.g., food, service, ambience, price) to identify semantic axes aligned with sentiment polarities.
